Released tools from my research. Each is open source and accompanies a paper.

::: {.software-entry}
### scEEMS

Single-cell Enhanced Expression Modifier Scores — a machine learning framework for predicting cell-type-resolved brain eQTLs, used to identify variants explaining Alzheimer's disease heritability.

[Code](https://github.com/daklab/scEEMS){.pub-btn target="_blank"} [Paper](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2025.12.03.25341562v1){.pub-btn target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### gruyere

Genome-wide Rare Variant EnRichment Evaluation — a rare-variant association test that leverages functional annotations, applied to Alzheimer disease (published in *AJHG*, 2025).

[Code](https://github.com/daklab/gruyere){.pub-btn target="_blank"} [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2025.07.016){.pub-btn target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### parmigiano

An empirical Bayes framework for burden and dispersion rare-variant association tests, used to prioritize rare variants associated with Alzheimer's disease.

[Code](https://github.com/daklab/parmigiano){.pub-btn target="_blank"} [Paper](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.06.15.26354742v1){.pub-btn target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### LDmat

Efficiently queryable compression of linkage disequilibrium matrices, released as a Python package on PyPI.

[Code](https://github.com/G2Lab/ldmat){.pub-btn target="_blank"} [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/ldmat/){.pub-btn target="_blank"} [Paper](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/39/2/btad092/7043094){.pub-btn target="_blank"}
:::
